prompt: Make a game-ready 3D prop from the crate image: about 3000 triangles, UV-mapped, PBR textures, GLB.

checks.run: python3 -I -c 'import json; s=json.load(open('"'"'stats.json'"'"')); r=json.load(open('"'"'references/stats.json'"'"')); assert 1<=s['"'"'components'"'"']<=r['"'"'components'"'"']*2, '"'"'components over twice reference'"'"''

python3 -I -c 'import json; s=json.load(open('"'"'stats.json'"'"')); r=json.load(open('"'"'references/stats.json'"'"')); a=[s['"'"'dimensions_m'"'"'][0]/s['"'"'dimensions_m'"'"'][1],s['"'"'dimensions_m'"'"'][2]/s['"'"'dimensions_m'"'"'][1]]; b=[r['"'"'dimensions_m'"'"'][0]/r['"'"'dimensions_m'"'"'][1],r['"'"'dimensions_m'"'"'][2]/r['"'"'dimensions_m'"'"'][1]]; assert all(abs(v-b[i])<=b[i]*0.15 for i,v in enumerate(a)), '"'"'proportions outside reference +-15%'"'"''

python3 -I -c 'import json; s=json.load(open('"'"'stats.json'"'"')); r=json.load(open('"'"'references/stats.json'"'"')); assert s['"'"'uv'"'"'] and s['"'"'pbr'"'"']['"'"'base_color'"'"'], '"'"'uv or base colour missing'"'"''
for v in front side top three-quarter; do test -s renders/$v.png || { echo "renders/$v.png missing"; exit 1; }; done
